expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and the gesture bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The system gesture/home indicator bar overlaps the bottom navigation icons. It strikes through the Search icon and crowds the Orders icon, so the tab bar looks broken. The tab icons also have no labels, and the bottom nav appears clipped at the screen edge.

In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké card has a light gray/white background while the other cards are dark. The time badge ('15–25 min') overlaps the plate illustration, and the plate is cut off at the right side of the image. This makes the first card look inconsistent.

The white heart icon on the pizza card's semi-transparent dark circle has weak contrast against the light pizza image. The green '€0 delivery' badge text on white is also small. The gray secondary text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min') is low contrast.
The promo banner has decorative translucent circles that create an uneven, hard-edged shape in the bottom right, with a visible corner artifact near the banner's edge.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the gesture bar overlapping the bottom navigation icons and the bottom navigation being clipped at the screen edge, matching the expected defect.
